日文.首段:
京阪2600系電車（けいはん2600けいでんしゃ）は、1978年（昭和53年）に登場した京阪電気鉄道（京阪）の通勤形電車。
1959年（昭和34年）登場の2000系（2200系からの編入車3両を含む全103両）の車体や台車と一部の機器を流用して自社寝屋川車両工場で製造された0番台103両と、車体等も含め全て新規で川崎重工兵庫工場にて製造された30番台28両の合計131両が製造された。
2001年（平成13年）から廃車が始まっており、2025年（令和7年）4月1日現在、30番台7両編成×2本の計14両が在籍する。

章节.投入の経緯・概要: 「0番台」と「30番台」は投入経緯が全く異なるため、分けて記述する。
章节.製造経緯・2000系と2600系0番台:
1959年（昭和34年）に登場し、「スーパーカー」の愛称で親しまれた2000系は、冷房化や1970年代から検討された架線電圧の600 Vから1,500 Vへの昇圧への対応が困難であり、103両もある2000系を新製車で置き換えるのも難しかった。
決定された1983年（昭和58年）実施の昇圧に向けて、当時の在籍車両の中でも車齢が比較的若い2000系は、2200系等と異なり、車籍を継がず書類上は新造車両（代替新造）の位置付けになる「車体流用」という形で自社工場（寝屋川車両工場）にて車両形式・番号を改め、更新・昇圧対応を行うことになった。
最長で車齢約20年（当時）となる2000系を代替するにあたって、1978年（昭和53年）から2043編成を皮切りに順次、2000系の車体・台車・一部の機器を流用しながら、複電圧仕様の回生ブレーキ付き制御装置への換装、冷房化などの改造を施し、事実上の2000系更新車（2000系改造車）である、2600系0番台として落成し、1982年（昭和57年）に2600系0番台への代替が完了した。2000系時代の姿をほぼ維持しており、2016年（平成28年）・2017年（平成29年）に京阪から発売された「鉄道コレクション」では、それを忠実に再現し、2600系としては存在しない区分である「2600系一次車」「2600系二次車」（いずれも2000系の一次車・二次車を意味する）という表記がなされ、2000系とほぼ同一視している。また、くずはモール内の「SANZEN-HIROBA」で2026年8月26日から開催された（同年9月30日終了予定）、同系列の引退記念企画展示で掲示された車両の写真では2000系の写真（2018号車）とともに”ありがとう 2600系”と表記されており、書類上は異なる車両ながら、こちらも 2000系と2600系0番台を同一視している 。
なお、車内に取り付けられた製造会社の銘板は、流用元の2000系の車体を製造したメーカー名ではなく、「京阪電鉄 寝屋川工場」と記されたものである。

1978年（昭和53年）6月23日に2043・2128・2044の車体を流用した2601F（2601-2701-2801）が竣工し、1982年（昭和57年）12月1日竣工の2905（旧2064）まで、計103両が寝屋川工場で改造された。全車竣工時の組成は、3両編成×5本、4両固定編成×6本、2両ごとに分割可能の4両編成×14本、2両編成×4本である。
基本編成の組成は2000系時代と同様となる（例:2000系3両→そのまま2600系0番台3両に改造・改番）。

主な更新（2600系への改造）内容
主電動機、主制御器などの主要制御器は昇圧に対応した新造品に交換
菱形パンタグラフから下枠交差型パンタグラフに交換
離線による回生制動不良などのリスク対策として付随車にもパンタグラフを装備
先頭車正面に行先表示器を設置し、同時に車番の位置を正面貫通扉から運転台側窓（向かって右側）の下に移動
後半に改造された編成では先頭車正面助士台側（向かって左側）の窓はHゴム支持の1枚固定窓に変更（本節3枚目の写真）。
前照灯を白熱灯から、ケースはそのままにシールドビームに交換
先頭車にスカート（排障装置）を設置
章节.車体: 車体の規格や形状は同一ながら、前述のとおり新たに製造されている。前照灯は、2000系当時の白熱灯の灯具にシールドビームを設置した0番台とは異なり、2400系以降と同様の形状のシールドビームを当初から装備している。標識灯も、2000系のものを流用した0番台と異なり、3000系で採用されたタイプを装備している。扉の窓は、枠がない2000系の扉を流用した0番台とは異なり、ステンレスの枠がある。製造時は先頭部に幌が設置されていたが、1986年（昭和61年）に撤去された。
章节.30番台（完全新造車）:
30番台は、0番台と基本的に同一の設計ながら、後に登場する6000系の走行システムを先取りした仕様で車体や台車も含めて、川崎重工にて新規に製造された。1981年（昭和56年）3月から5月にかけて1800系の代替として7両編成×2本、同年12月に輸送力増強に対応した増備用として7両編成×2本の合計28両が製造され、いずれも製造後数日以内に営業を開始した。
30番台第4編成（2634F）を最後に2000系から続いた、いわゆる「卵型電車」の製造は編成単位では終了し、約1年半後の1983年（昭和58年）にはそれまでの京阪のイメージを大きく覆す6000系が登場した。高性能電車黎明期の雰囲気を残す車体が1980年代に新製されている点は貴重とされる。
章节.内装: 車内の座席はロングシートである。モケット・化粧板・床面とも、緑系でまとめられている。内装デザインは2200系とほぼ同じである。側扉は、0番台は上半分が化粧板と同じグリーン塗装、下半分が化粧板張りとなっているが、30番台は全面化粧板張りである。また、側扉の窓ガラスの支持方法も異なっている。
章节.機器:
最高速度110 km/h、起動加速度2.5 km/h/sと、2000系時代と比べて性能が大幅に変化している。加速を抑え、高速向きにしたことにより、性能面では2200系とほぼ同等になっている。主電動機は複巻電動機の「TDK-8135A」で600 V時130 kW、1,500 Vでは155 kWである。制御器は界磁位相制御の ACRF-H4155-775A が採用された（ともに東洋電機製造製）。2000系に引き続き分巻界磁制御による回生ブレーキを使用する。電動発電機（MG）は、3両編成以外には、冷房電源確保のための大容量MG（TDK-3721A）が搭載された。2905 - 2910は、4両での冷房使用時の電源容量不足を補うため、出力70 kVAのもの（MG：TDK-3721A）が搭載された（2905は2632Fに組み込まれて8両化された時に重量軽減策として外された）。2801 - 2810は、補助電源装置は1基のMGで3両分の冷房電源を賄う予定で、出力140 kVAのもの（TDK-3755A）が搭載されていた。
パンタグラフは剛体架線対応の下枠交差型パンタグラフ（PT-4805A-M）である。パンタグラフは、電動車全車に加えて、制御車の2811 - 2828、付随車の2911 - 2924にも設置されている。なお、2601 - 2610のパンタグラフ横のヒューズ箱の数が2個と、他の2600形より1つ少ない。
章节.冷房装置:
2621F・2622F以外の各車両は、PRU-2205A を4台搭載している。
2621F・2622Fは、冷房装置の試験車で、東芝の RPU-3007（10,500 kcal/h）を3台搭載しており、外観が異なっているほか、車内には新設計のグリルファンが9基設置されて冷房効果の試験がなされた。その結果を元に6000系に三菱製 CU-197（10,500 kcal/h）が採用された。
章节.台車:
本系列の台車は多種多様であり、既に消滅した4種類を含めると、のべ17種類に及ぶ。台車の交換や振り替えも行われており、保守負担の多い台車を、廃車となった車両から供出された経年の浅い台車に交換している。

FS327A
住友金属工業（現：新日鐵住金→日本製鉄）製、アルストムリンク式。2000系初期車に由来するもので、制輪子が車輪外側にあることから、床下スペースの関係上全て付随台車として使用。数を減らしており、現履くのは1両のみ。
FS337/337A/337B/337C
住友金属工業（現：新日鐵住金→日本製鉄）製、緩衝ゴム式。FS337Bは2200系T車に由来するもので、全て付随台車として使用。その他は2000系中期・後期車に由来するもので、電動台車または付随台車として使用。
FS399C
住友金属工業（現：新日鐵住金→日本製鉄）製、緩衝ゴム式。30番台T車が登場時に履いていたもので、KW79 の導入によって一部が0番台に転用されている。電動台車または付随台車として使用。
FS509/509A
住友金属工業（現：新日鐵住金→日本製鉄）製、SU型ミンデン式。旧式台車の交換用に製造されたもので、電動台車または付随台車として使用。新しいにもかかわらず数を減らしており、FS509 は既に消滅している。
KS58
汽車製造製、油浸円筒案内式（シンドラー式）。2000系初期車に由来するもので、基礎ブレーキ装置が両抱き式で制輪子や連動てこなどのブレーキ機構が車輪外側にあることから、床下スペースの関係上全て付随台車として使用。
KS63/63A/63C
汽車製造製、軸箱梁式（エコノミカル台車）。2000系中期車に由来するもので、電動台車または付随台車として使用。乗り心地に問題があったと言われ、いずれも既に消滅している。
KS73C
汽車製造製、軸箱梁式（エコノミカル台車）。2000系後期車に由来するもので、電動台車または付随台車として使用。
KW37
川崎重工業製、乾式円筒案内式。30番台M車が登場時から履いているほか、旧式台車の交換用にも製造された。電動台車として使用。
KW69/69A
川崎重工業製、軸梁式。KW69は本系列の、KW69Aは1900系の旧式台車交換用に製造されたもので、KW69は電動台車または付随台車として、KW69Aは全て付随台車として使用。
KW79
川崎重工業製、油浸円筒案内式（シンドラー式）。3000系Tc車で使用していたKS132Aをインダイレクトマウント化改造したもので、全て30番台のT車・Tc車で使用。
章节.製造:
2601F - 2610Fは、当初は2600（Mc）- 2700（M）- 2800（Tc）の3両固定編成で竣工し、番号順に2本ずつ繋いだ6両編成で運用された。2605F - 2610Fには後から追加で2900形（T）が組み込まれて4両化された。

凡例
太字：車端部の側面窓が1枚
斜字：制御車・付随車でパンタグラフ搭載
下線：元2200系制御車
*車番：京都方の運転台撤去車
車番*：大阪方の運転台撤去車

2611F - 2624Fは、当初は2600（Mc）- 2900（T）+ 2700（M）- 2800（Tc）の4両編成であり、2両+2両に分割可能な構成である。

2625F - 2628Fは、2600（Mc）- 2800（Tc）の2両編成で、ほかの編成と組み合わせて4両以上の編成で運用される。鴨東線開業前に出町柳駅から叡山電鉄線への直通運転が検討されていた時期もあったことから叡電の輸送需要に合わせて最短2両編成での運用も可能な仕様になっているが、直通運転構想は実現しておらず、その仕様は活かされていない。

2629-2729-2829は、2200系と編成を組む。1980年代中期には2400系と編成を組んでいた時期もあったが、後に元の2200系との組成（当時は2210Fと組んでいた）に戻っている。2006年（平成18年）に連結相手の2200系が回生ブレーキ仕様の2210Fから発電ブレーキ仕様の2218Fに替わった後、2009年（平成21年）11月30日に廃車された。

ユニットの組み合わせを変えることによって4両から8両までの編成を組むことが可能であり、その特徴を活かした運用がなされた。廃車や運転台が撤去された車両（車両番号はそのまま）も発生したことから、より雑多な編成となっている。
なお、0番台だけで8両編成を組む場合、2800形（Tc）並びに2900形（T）には必ず大容量MGが装備されており、4M4Tの編成では編成重量が増加するなどの制約から、5M3Tの編成としてカバーすることがほとんどであったが、過去には4両編成を2本つなげた4M4Tの暫定の8両編成での運用実績もある。
また、これまでは暫定編成などでしか見られなかった7両編成が2006年（平成18年）7月頃から正規の編成としても組まれている（公式サイトの編成表にも掲載）。
30番台は4両ユニット+3両ユニットの7両編成で製造された。0番台と連結して運行することが可能である。1980年代後半頃から2003年（平成15年）9月のダイヤ改正までは編成を分割して0番台と組み、5両編成や6両編成で運転されていた編成もあったが、以後は登場当時と同様に30番台のみで7両編成×4本を組む。
章节.中間制御車の中間車化改造: 編成中間に入っている運転台付の車両について、2007年（平成19年）以降、前面スカート・乗務員用ステップ・乗務員室扉握り棒の撤去などが施工されている。車両番号は変更されていないが、書類上の形式は、2600形が2700形に、2800形が2900形に変更されている。
章节.新塗装化:
2008年（平成20年）から車体塗装の変更が始まり、2011年（平成23年）4月までに39両で実施された。2013年（平成25年）5月までに廃車予定となっている車両を除く全車両の塗装変更が完了した。
新塗装化が進行中の時期には、旧塗装の車両と新塗装の車両が同一の編成内で混在する事例も見られた。
新塗装の検討にあたって、寝屋川車庫で休車となっていた2825に3種類の塗装が施されていた。その後、2825も新塗装化されている。
ただし、廃車後寝屋川車庫内で教材車として活用されている2615・2820の2両は2017年（平成29年）9月現在も旧塗装のままである。
章节.京阪ミュージアムトレイン: 2010年（平成22年）、京阪開業100周年記念事業として実施された巡業展示「京阪ミュージアムトレイン」として、2602-2702-2802-2712-2812 の5両が使用された。これらの車両は座席を撤去のうえ展示物が配置されたほか、塗装を1550型（初代600型）をイメージしたモスグリーンに塗りかえている。
章节.運用:
本系列のうち0番台は2000系時代から普通運用が主体となっている。30番台は当初急行にも使われていたが、本線で2200系や6000系による8両編成の運用が開始されてからはこちらも普通運用が主体となった。ただ本形式も不定期的ではあるが8両編成での運用実績はある。2003年9月のダイヤ改定頃、6両編成での運用は消滅し、組み替えの上、全編成が4・5・7両となった。また、このダイヤ改正で、平日朝ラッシュ時に交野線私市駅発淀屋橋駅行き直通列車のK特急「おりひめ」が、同夕ラッシュ時には天満橋駅発私市行きの準急「ひこぼし」が設定され、イベント時などを除き前者には本系列5両編成が、後者には1900系または本系列の5両編成が充当となっていた。
30番台も5両編成で宇治線・交野線に入線したことがあり、「おりひめ」に充当されたこともある。
2007年（平成19年）9月からの交野線で実施されているワンマン運転には対応しておらず、ワンマン運転を行う運用には入っていない。
「おりひめ」・「ひこぼし」は2008年（平成20年）10月19日のダイヤ改定でそれぞれ交野線・中之島線直通の通勤快急・快速急行となり、ともに本系列5両編成が充当されていた（10000系を充当していた「ひこぼし」の1本を除く）が、2013年（平成25年）3月16日のダイヤ改定で廃止された。
また、13000系の登場と宇治線でのワンマン運転開始により、2013年（平成25年）5月をもって、4両編成についても2600系の定期運用はなくなった。
以降は他形式の7両編成と同じく急行以下のみの運用となったが、2016年（平成28年）3月19日のダイヤ改正では7両編成による通勤快急・快速急行運用が設定されたことにより、「おりひめ」、「ひこぼし」運用ではないものの、本系列の通勤快急・快速急行運用の機会が3年ぶりに復活している。
2021年（令和5年）9月のダイヤ改正以降、0番台車による定期運用はなくなっている。
章节.0番台:
0番台に関しては、2001年（平成13年）から廃車が始まっており、2001年（平成13年）12月28日付けで2622F（4両編成）と2905・2906・2910が、2002年（平成14年）3月18日付けで2611F（4両編成）が、同年4月22日付けで2627-2827と2714-2814が、同月25日付けで2616F（4両編成）が廃車となった。

この際廃車となった車両は2003年（平成15年）3月に外部への売却先を募集し、2627号車の前頭部カットモデルが個人の鉄道ファンに譲渡された。また2811号車の前頭部がキッズプラザ大阪に譲渡され、館内で車椅子の体験設備として用いられている。この他、台車（FS-509・FS-327A 各1基）が東京大学生産技術研究所に譲渡された。
続いて2006年（平成18年）3月29日付けで2618-2918・2907・2908が廃車となった。
2200系列と連結されていた2629-2729-2829も、2009年（平成21年）9月12日のダイヤ変更で、編成を組んでいた2218ほか4両とともに運用から外れ、ともにそのまま11月30日に廃車された。また、2610F・2612-2912・2909も同日付けで廃車となった。
2010年（平成22年）12月31日には、先述の「京阪ミュージアムトレイン」として使用された2602・2702・2802・2712・2812が廃車となった。
新塗装化された2604Fも2011年（平成23年）6月30日付けで一緒に編成を組んでいた2724-2824と共に廃車となった。

2012年（平成24年）4月から7月にかけて13000系4両編成×5本（13001F - 13005F）が投入され、2613F・2615F・2617F・2620F・2621Fの4両編成×5本が廃車となった。このうち、2615Fと2620Fのそれぞれ片方の先頭車で2両編成を組成し（2615-2820）、寝屋川車庫の教材車となった。
さらに、2013年（平成25年）4月30日付けで2606・2706・2806・2626・2826・2605・2705・2805が、同年5月31日付けで2628・2828・2608・2708・2808が廃車となった。続いて、2013年（平成25年）3月より宇治線の予備編成となっていた2623Fが2015年（平成27年）7月31日付けで廃車となった。

== 投入の経緯・概要 ==
「0番台」と「30番台」は投入経緯が全く異なるため、分けて記述する。


=== 0番台（2000系改造車） ===


==== 製造経緯・2000系と2600系0番台 ====
1959年（昭和34年）に登場し、「スーパーカー」の愛称で親しまれた2000系は、冷房化や1970年代から検討された架線電圧の600 Vから1,500 Vへの昇圧への対応が困難であり、103両もある2000系を新製車で置き換えるのも難しかった。
決定された1983年（昭和58年）実施の昇圧に向けて、当時の在籍車両の中でも車齢が比較的若い2000系は、2200系等と異なり、車籍を継がず書類上は新造車両（代替新造）の位置付けになる「車体流用」という形で自社工場（寝屋川車両工場）にて車両形式・番号を改め、更新・昇圧対応を行うことになった。
最長で車齢約20年（当時）となる2000系を代替するにあたって、1978年（昭和53年）から2043編成を皮切りに順次、2000系の車体・台車・一部の機器を流用しながら、複電圧仕様の回生ブレーキ付き制御装置への換装、冷房化などの改造を施し、事実上の2000系更新車（2000系改造車）である、2600系0番台として落成し、1982年（昭和57年）に2600系0番台への代替が完了した。2000系時代の姿をほぼ維持しており、2016年（平成28年）・2017年（平成29年）に京阪から発売された「鉄道コレクション」では、それを忠実に再現し、2600系としては存在しない区分である「2600系一次車」「2600系二次車」（いずれも2000系の一次車・二次車を意味する）という表記がなされ、2000系とほぼ同一視している。また、くずはモール内の「SANZEN-HIROBA」で2026年8月26日から開催された（同年9月30日終了予定）、同系列の引退記念企画展示で掲示された車両の写真では2000系の写真（2018号車）とともに”ありがとう 2600系”と表記されており、書類上は異なる車両ながら、こちらも 2000系と2600系0番台を同一視している 。
なお、車内に取り付けられた製造会社の銘板は、流用元の2000系の車体を製造したメーカー名ではなく、「京阪電鉄 寝屋川工場」と記されたものである。

1978年（昭和53年）6月23日に2043・2128・2044の車体を流用した2601F（2601-2701-2801）が竣工し、1982年（昭和57年）12月1日竣工の2905（旧2064）まで、計103両が寝屋川工場で改造された。全車竣工時の組成は、3両編成×5本、4両固定編成×6本、2両ごとに分割可能の4両編成×14本、2両編成×4本である。
基本編成の組成は2000系時代と同様となる（例:2000系3両→そのまま2600系0番台3両に改造・改番）。

主な更新（2600系への改造）内容
主電動機、主制御器などの主要制御器は昇圧に対応した新造品に交換
菱形パンタグラフから下枠交差型パンタグラフに交換
離線による回生制動不良などのリスク対策として付随車にもパンタグラフを装備
先頭車正面に行先表示器を設置し、同時に車番の位置を正面貫通扉から運転台側窓（向かって右側）の下に移動
後半に改造された編成では先頭車正面助士台側（向かって左側）の窓はHゴム支持の1枚固定窓に変更（本節3枚目の写真）。
前照灯を白熱灯から、ケースはそのままにシールドビームに交換
先頭車にスカート（排障装置）を設置


==== 車体 ====
車体は鋼製で、全長18.7 mの両開き3扉車である。車体の流用元の2000系の形態を引き継ぎながら、2000系からの改造時に、電圧指令式前面行先表示器の取り付け、スカートの取り付け、前照灯のシールドビーム化も施されている。
2600形・2800形のうち、2000系2001 - 2024の車体流用車の24両は、他の車両に比べて側窓の幅が100 mm広い900 mmとなっており、窓配置が異なっている。改造時期の違いで正面の車掌台側の窓が二段窓の車両と1枚の固定窓の車両があり、1980年（昭和55年）11月以降に竣工した車両は、車掌台側の前面窓が1枚の固定窓となっている。
中間車の2700形（M）のうち2720 - 2724、2900形（T）のうち2905・2911・2915・2920 - 2924は、もともと先頭車として製造された車両の車体を流用しており、運転台撤去跡が残っている。
2629-2729-2829は、2200系で唯一4両編成で残っていた2210Fと組むことを目的として登場した編成で、ほかの0番台とは形態が異なる。当初は種別・行先表示などが同系列と同じシーケンス式の仕様のもので、前面扉の窓下の行先表示器がなく、車両番号が前面運転台側に取り付けられたが異色の存在であった。1988年（昭和63年）9月に2200系の車体更新に併せて、2829には前面扉の外開化、前面扉の窓下に行先表示器の取り付け、2629は運転台を完全撤去して2700形化した（車両番号はそのまま）。制御機器は2600系で、設備は2200系という異端車両になった。
なお、車体流用元となった2000系には、2200系から2000系に編入された経歴の車両も3両含まれている。


=== 30番台（完全新造車） ===

30番台は、0番台と基本的に同一の設計ながら、後に登場する6000系の走行システムを先取りした仕様で車体や台車も含めて、川崎重工にて新規に製造された。1981年（昭和56年）3月から5月にかけて1800系の代替として7両編成×2本、同年12月に輸送力増強に対応した増備用として7両編成×2本の合計28両が製造され、いずれも製造後数日以内に営業を開始した。
30番台第4編成（2634F）を最後に2000系から続いた、いわゆる「卵型電車」の製造は編成単位では終了し、約1年半後の1983年（昭和58年）にはそれまでの京阪のイメージを大きく覆す6000系が登場した。高性能電車黎明期の雰囲気を残す車体が1980年代に新製されている点は貴重とされる。


==== 車体 ====
車体の規格や形状は同一ながら、前述のとおり新たに製造されている。前照灯は、2000系当時の白熱灯の灯具にシールドビームを設置した0番台とは異なり、2400系以降と同様の形状のシールドビームを当初から装備している。標識灯も、2000系のものを流用した0番台と異なり、3000系で採用されたタイプを装備している。扉の窓は、枠がない2000系の扉を流用した0番台とは異なり、ステンレスの枠がある。製造時は先頭部に幌が設置されていたが、1986年（昭和61年）に撤去された。


== 内装 ==
車内の座席はロングシートである。モケット・化粧板・床面とも、緑系でまとめられている。内装デザインは2200系とほぼ同じである。側扉は、0番台は上半分が化粧板と同じグリーン塗装、下半分が化粧板張りとなっているが、30番台は全面化粧板張りである。また、側扉の窓ガラスの支持方法も異なっている。


== 機器 ==
最高速度110 km/h、起動加速度2.5 km/h/sと、2000系時代と比べて性能が大幅に変化している。加速を抑え、高速向きにしたことにより、性能面では2200系とほぼ同等になっている。主電動機は複巻電動機の「TDK-8135A」で600 V時130 kW、1,500 Vでは155 kWである。制御器は界磁位相制御の ACRF-H4155-775A が採用された（ともに東洋電機製造製）。2000系に引き続き分巻界磁制御による回生ブレーキを使用する。電動発電機（MG）は、3両編成以外には、冷房電源確保のための大容量MG（TDK-3721A）が搭載された。2905 - 2910は、4両での冷房使用時の電源容量不足を補うため、出力70 kVAのもの（MG：TDK-3721A）が搭載された（2905は2632Fに組み込まれて8両化された時に重量軽減策として外された）。2801 - 2810は、補助電源装置は1基のMGで3両分の冷房電源を賄う予定で、出力140 kVAのもの（TDK-3755A）が搭載されていた。
パンタグラフは剛体架線対応の下枠交差型パンタグラフ（PT-4805A-M）である。パンタグラフは、電動車全車に加えて、制御車の2811 - 2828、付随車の2911 - 2924にも設置されている。なお、2601 - 2610のパンタグラフ横のヒューズ箱の数が2個と、他の2600形より1つ少ない。


=== 冷房装置 ===

2621F・2622F以外の各車両は、PRU-2205A を4台搭載している。
2621F・2622Fは、冷房装置の試験車で、東芝の RPU-3007（10,500 kcal/h）を3台搭載しており、外観が異なっているほか、車内には新設計のグリルファンが9基設置されて冷房効果の試験がなされた。その結果を元に6000系に三菱製 CU-197（10,500 kcal/h）が採用された。

2629-2729-2829は、2200系と編成を組む。1980年代中期には2400系と編成を組んでいた時期もあったが、後に元の2200系との組成（当時は2210Fと組んでいた）に戻っている。2006年（平成18年）に連結相手の2200系が回生ブレーキ仕様の2210Fから発電ブレーキ仕様の2218Fに替わった後、2009年（平成21年）11月30日に廃車された。

ユニットの組み合わせを変えることによって4両から8両までの編成を組むことが可能であり、その特徴を活かした運用がなされた。廃車や運転台が撤去された車両（車両番号はそのまま）も発生したことから、より雑多な編成となっている。
なお、0番台だけで8両編成を組む場合、2800形（Tc）並びに2900形（T）には必ず大容量MGが装備されており、4M4Tの編成では編成重量が増加するなどの制約から、5M3Tの編成としてカバーすることがほとんどであったが、過去には4両編成を2本つなげた4M4Tの暫定の8両編成での運用実績もある。
また、これまでは暫定編成などでしか見られなかった7両編成が2006年（平成18年）7月頃から正規の編成としても組まれている（公式サイトの編成表にも掲載）。
30番台は4両ユニット+3両ユニットの7両編成で製造された。0番台と連結して運行することが可能である。1980年代後半頃から2003年（平成15年）9月のダイヤ改正までは編成を分割して0番台と組み、5両編成や6両編成で運転されていた編成もあったが、以後は登場当時と同様に30番台のみで7両編成×4本を組む。


== 改造工事 ==


=== 中間制御車の中間車化改造 ===
編成中間に入っている運転台付の車両について、2007年（平成19年）以降、前面スカート・乗務員用ステップ・乗務員室扉握り棒の撤去などが施工されている。車両番号は変更されていないが、書類上の形式は、2600形が2700形に、2800形が2900形に変更されている。


=== 新塗装化 ===

2008年（平成20年）から車体塗装の変更が始まり、2011年（平成23年）4月までに39両で実施された。2013年（平成25年）5月までに廃車予定となっている車両を除く全車両の塗装変更が完了した。
新塗装化が進行中の時期には、旧塗装の車両と新塗装の車両が同一の編成内で混在する事例も見られた。
新塗装の検討にあたって、寝屋川車庫で休車となっていた2825に3種類の塗装が施されていた。その後、2825も新塗装化されている。
ただし、廃車後寝屋川車庫内で教材車として活用されている2615・2820の2両は2017年（平成29年）9月現在も旧塗装のままである。


== 京阪ミュージアムトレイン ==
2010年（平成22年）、京阪開業100周年記念事業として実施された巡業展示「京阪ミュージアムトレイン」として、2602-2702-2802-2712-2812 の5両が使用された。これらの車両は座席を撤去のうえ展示物が配置されたほか、塗装を1550型（初代600型）をイメージしたモスグリーンに塗りかえている。


== 運用 ==
本系列のうち0番台は2000系時代から普通運用が主体となっている。30番台は当初急行にも使われていたが、本線で2200系や6000系による8両編成の運用が開始されてからはこちらも普通運用が主体となった。ただ本形式も不定期的ではあるが8両編成での運用実績はある。2003年9月のダイヤ改定頃、6両編成での運用は消滅し、組み替えの上、全編成が4・5・7両となった。また、このダイヤ改正で、平日朝ラッシュ時に交野線私市駅発淀屋橋駅行き直通列車のK特急「おりひめ」が、同夕ラッシュ時には天満橋駅発私市行きの準急「ひこぼし」が設定され、イベント時などを除き前者には本系列5両編成が、後者には1900系または本系列の5両編成が充当となっていた。
30番台も5両編成で宇治線・交野線に入線したことがあり、「おりひめ」に充当されたこともある。
2007年（平成19年）9月からの交野線で実施されているワンマン運転には対応しておらず、ワンマン運転を行う運用には入っていない。
「おりひめ」・「ひこぼし」は2008年（平成20年）10月19日のダイヤ改定でそれぞれ交野線・中之島線直通の通勤快急・快速急行となり、ともに本系列5両編成が充当されていた（10000系を充当していた「ひこぼし」の1本を除く）が、2013年（平成25年）3月16日のダイヤ改定で廃止された。
また、13000系の登場と宇治線でのワンマン運転開始により、2013年（平成25年）5月をもって、4両編成についても2600系の定期運用はなくなった。
以降は他形式の7両編成と同じく急行以下のみの運用となったが、2016年（平成28年）3月19日のダイヤ改正では7両編成による通勤快急・快速急行運用が設定されたことにより、「おりひめ」、「ひこぼし」運用ではないものの、本系列の通勤快急・快速急行運用の機会が3年ぶりに復活している。
2021年（令和5年）9月のダイヤ改正以降、0番台車による定期運用はなくなっている。


== 廃車 ==


=== 0番台 ===
0番台に関しては、2001年（平成13年）から廃車が始まっており、2001年（平成13年）12月28日付けで2622F（4両編成）と2905・2906・2910が、2002年（平成14年）3月18日付けで2611F（4両編成）が、同年4月22日付けで2627-2827と2714-2814が、同月25日付けで2616F（4両編成）が廃車となった。

この際廃車となった車両は2003年（平成15年）3月に外部への売却先を募集し、2627号車の前頭部カットモデルが個人の鉄道ファンに譲渡された。また2811号車の前頭部がキッズプラザ大阪に譲渡され、館内で車椅子の体験設備として用いられている。この他、台車（FS-509・FS-327A 各1基）が東京大学生産技術研究所に譲渡された。
続いて2006年（平成18年）3月29日付けで2618-2918・2907・2908が廃車となった。
2200系列と連結されていた2629-2729-2829も、2009年（平成21年）9月12日のダイヤ変更で、編成を組んでいた2218ほか4両とともに運用から外れ、ともにそのまま11月30日に廃車された。また、2610F・2612-2912・2909も同日付けで廃車となった。
2010年（平成22年）12月31日には、先述の「京阪ミュージアムトレイン」として使用された2602・2702・2802・2712・2812が廃車となった。
新塗装化された2604Fも2011年（平成23年）6月30日付けで一緒に編成を組んでいた2724-2824と共に廃車となった。

2012年（平成24年）4月から7月にかけて13000系4両編成×5本（13001F - 13005F）が投入され、2613F・2615F・2617F・2620F・2621Fの4両編成×5本が廃車となった。このうち、2615Fと2620Fのそれぞれ片方の先頭車で2両編成を組成し（2615-2820）、寝屋川車庫の教材車となった。
さらに、2013年（平成25年）4月30日付けで2606・2706・2806・2626・2826・2605・2705・2805が、同年5月31日付けで2628・2828・2608・2708・2808が廃車となった。続いて、2013年（平成25年）3月より宇治線の予備編成となっていた2623Fが2015年（平成27年）7月31日付けで廃車となった。
2016年（平成28年）度から2020年（令和2年）度までは、京橋駅のホームドア設置に伴い、乗降位置が異なる5000系の置き換えが優先され、本形式の廃車はなく、2021年（令和3年）4月時点で、2000系からの車体流用車である0番台は7両編成×3本が在籍した。そのうち2624と2818は2000系1次車の車体を流用した車両で（流用元の車体は2007および2006）、車体塗装の変更、前照灯のLED化等を経ながら2019年（令和元年）には車体の製造から60年を迎えた。その後、5000系の置き換えがおおむね完了したことにより2021年（令和3年）より廃車が再開され、7月6日付けで2609Fが廃車となった。このうち、2609Fのそれぞれ片方の先頭車で2両編成を組成し（2609-2825）、2代目の寝屋川車庫の教材車となり（2615-2820）を置き換えた。
さらに2022年（令和4年）9月12日付けで2601・2701・2801が廃車となった。
2023年（令和5年）11月8日付けで2624F、同年12月5日付けで2718・2818・2619・2819が廃車となり、2600系0番台は先述の寝屋川車庫の教材車を除いて消滅した。


=== 30番台 ===
一方で、30番台に関しては、登場以降、先頭車前面貫通幌の撤去、車体塗装の新塗装への変更、前照灯のLED化が行われたものの、更新工事は実施されないままで、2025年（令和7年）4月現在、7両編成×2本の計14両が在籍している。
2024年（令和6年）10月25日に、13000系を2026年（令和8年）度までに67両を導入し、残存する1000系・2200系・2400系とともに13000系既存車との組み替えと合わせ置き換えが発表され、30番台も順次置き換えられる予定で、2025年（令和7年）3月には、2633F・2634Fが廃車になった。
2026年8月21日をもって、2200系・2400系とともに営業運転を終了した。

== その他 ==

2626F・2628Fの4両は、1986年（昭和61年）の京都地下線の工事に試運転車両として松原通り付近に設けられた仮設搬入口から搬入され、地下線での地下設備の確認・試運転・ATS装置の確認、最後に運転士の訓練運転などに使用された。

中文.首段: 京阪2600系電聯車（日語：京阪2600系電車／けいはん2600けいでんしゃ，羅馬化：Keihan 2600-kei densha）是京阪電氣鐵道於1978年至2026年8月使用的電聯車。2600系是京阪電車為汰換暱稱為「Super Car」的京阪2000系電聯車而導入的新型車輛。而為增備電聯車與替換初代京阪1800系電聯車，京阪電車在1980年至1981年間共導入28輛全新打造的2630番台車輛。本型車的最後一列編組於2026年8月21日隨著列車時刻表改點退出服務。

章节.0番台（2000系改造車輛）:
京阪電車於1959年投入使用，並且因擁有暱稱「Super Car」而廣受乘客喜愛的京阪2000系電聯車在安裝空調系統及因應京阪電車在1970年代起開始研議的電車線電壓升壓一事上遭遇困難（從600V升壓至1500V）。但京阪電車也難以透過導入新車的方式將車輛總數達102輛的2000系全數更換。為因應該公司計畫於1983年實施的電車線升壓工程，不同於京阪2200系電聯車在保留車籍的狀況下改造，京阪電車決定將當時的車輛中車齡較年輕的2000系註銷車籍，在挪用原有車體的狀況下將其視為新造車輛，並在自社的寢屋川車輛工廠實施更改車輛編號、翻新作業與因應電車線升壓的相關改造。
為替換當時車齡最長約20年的2000系電聯車，京阪電車自1978年起以2043編組為首開始實施相關的改造工程，除沿用2000系的車體、轉向架和部分機電設備外，其列車制軔也替換成能因應雙電壓規格的再生制軔，並同步安裝空調設備。為防止列車的集電弓在行駛時脫離高架電車線導致再生制軔失效，2600系的無動力車廂在改造時也被加裝集電弓。列車的目的地顯示器被安裝在前頭車的正面，而原本設置在正面貫通門上的車輛編號也被移至駕駛台側面窗戶的下方車身處。前述車輛實際上即為2000系的更新車輛（改造車），並且被編為2600系的0番台；而京阪電車則在1982年完成2600系番台的替換作業。

由於2600系幾乎保留原2000系的外觀，京阪電車在2016年及2017年發售的2600系鐵道模型「鐵道Collection」中除了還原2000系的相關細節外，也在官方新聞稿中使用實際上不存在的「2600系一次車」和「2600系二次車」的分類標示，顯示京阪電車基本上將2600系視為與2000系同款的車型。
章节.車體: 2600系的車體採用鋼打造，其單節車廂的長度為18.7m，並在左右兩側的車身各別配置3道旅客用車門。在2600系的2600型和2800型車中，共有24輛車是沿用原2000系2001－2024號車的車體；而該批車的側窗寬度與其他的同型車相比寬100mm，其窗戶配置也有所差異。而受到改造時間的差異影響，車頭正面的車掌台側的側窗分為兩段式開關的窗戶和單面的固定窗；而在1980年11月後完工的2600系車掌台側的側窗均改為單片的固定窗設計。在2600系的中間車中，2700型動力車的2720－2724號車和2900型無動力車廂的2905、2911、2915及2920 - 2924號車原本是作為前頭車而製造的車廂，而上述車廂的內部在改造後仍保留著駕駛台遭到拆除後的痕跡。
章节.30番台（新造車輛）: 2600系的30番台基本上採用與0番台相同的設計，並先行使用後來導入的京阪6000系電聯車所採用的列車行駛系統。30番台共有28輛車，其中第一批為1983年3月至5月製造的2列7輛編組，以替換初代1800系電聯車；第二批則是於同年12月作為增備車製造的2列7輛編組，以提升列車的運能。上述兩批車均在出廠後的數日內投入運行。隨著30番台的第4列編組2634出廠並投入使用，京阪電車自2000系以來所採用的硬殼式構造「卵型電車」的製造歷史正式告終。1983年，顛覆京阪電車形象的6000系電聯車開始投入使用。而像30番台這種在1980年代新造並保留高性能電聯車新時期特色的車體對於日本的鐵道界來說是相當珍貴的案例。
章节.構造: 2600系的客室採用長型座椅，座椅的絨布、化粧板和車廂地板均使用綠色系的塗裝，內裝設計則幾乎與2200系的客室設計相同。0番台的旅客用車門上半部採用與化粧板相同的綠色塗裝，並在下半部貼上化粧板；30番台的旅客用車門表面則全數貼上化粧板。而上述2種車在固定側窗玻璃的方式上也有所不同。關於轉向架，若包含已不再使用的類型，2600系所使用的轉向架種類多達17種。而本型車的轉向架也時常遭到更換，例如京阪電車會將維修負擔較重的轉向架拆下來，並替換成從其他報廢車輛拆下來且使用年份較短的轉向架。

=== 0 subclass (cars rebuilt from the 2000 series) ===

==== Manufacturing background: the 2000 series and the 2600 series 0 subclass ====
The 2000 series, which entered service in 1959 (Shōwa 34) and was affectionately known by the nickname “Supercar,” was difficult to equip with air conditioning and to adapt to the increase in overhead wire voltage from 600 V to 1,500 V that had been under consideration since the 1970s, and replacing all 103 cars of the 2000 series with newly built cars was also difficult.

Toward the voltage increase decided to be carried out in 1983 (Shōwa 58), the 2000 series, which was relatively young among the cars then in service, was, unlike the 2200 series, to be given new car types and numbers at the company's own works (Neyagawa Vehicle Works) in the form of “car body reuse,” in which the cars would not inherit their registration but would be positioned as newly built cars (replacement new construction) on paper, and to be updated and adapted to the higher voltage.

In replacing the 2000 series, which was at most about 20 years old (at the time), starting in 1978 (Shōwa 53) with set 2043 as the first, the cars were rebuilt successively by reusing the car bodies, bogies, and some equipment of the 2000 series while converting to dual-voltage control equipment with regenerative braking and adding air conditioning and other modifications, and were completed as the 2600 series 0 subclass, effectively updated cars of the 2000 series (cars rebuilt from the 2000 series); replacement with the 2600 series 0 subclass was completed in 1982 (Shōwa 57). They almost retain their appearance from the 2000 series era, and in the “Tetsudō Collection” models released by Keihan in 2016 (Heisei 28) and 2017 (Heisei 29), this was faithfully reproduced, and they were labeled with the designations “2600 series first batch” and “2600 series second batch” (both meaning the first and second batches of the 2000 series), which are classifications that do not exist for the 2600 series, essentially treating them as identical to the 2000 series. Also, in a memorial exhibition for the retirement of the series held at “SANZEN-HIROBA” inside Kuzuha Mall from August 26, 2026 (scheduled to end September 30 of the same year), the photographs of cars displayed there, together with a photograph of a 2000 series car (car 2018), were captioned “Thank you, 2600 series,” likewise treating the 2000 series and the 2600 series 0 subclass as identical despite being different cars on paper.

The manufacturer's nameplate installed inside the cars does not bear the name of the maker that built the reused 2000 series car bodies, but reads “Keihan Electric Railway Neyagawa Works.”

On June 23, 1978 (Shōwa 53), 2601F (2601-2701-2801), which reused the car bodies of 2043, 2128, and 2044, was completed, and up to 2905 (formerly 2064), completed on December 1, 1982 (Shōwa 57), a total of 103 cars were rebuilt at the Neyagawa Works. The composition at the time of completion of all cars was five 3-car sets, six 4-car fixed sets, fourteen 4-car sets splittable into 2+2 cars, and four 2-car sets.

The composition of the basic sets was the same as in the 2000 series era (e.g., a 3-car 2000 series set was rebuilt and renumbered as is into a 3-car 2600 series 0 subclass set).

Main contents of the update (rebuilding into the 2600 series)
* Main motors, main controllers, and other main control equipment were replaced with newly built items compatible with the higher voltage
* Diamond-shaped pantographs were replaced with lower-frame cross-type pantographs
* To guard against risks such as poor regenerative braking due to contact loss, pantographs were also fitted to trailer cars
* Destination indicators were installed on the front of the leading cars, and at the same time the position of the car number was moved from the front gangway door to below the cab-side window (on the right as viewed)
* In sets rebuilt in the latter period, the window on the assistant driver's side (on the left as viewed) of the front of the leading car was changed to a single fixed window supported by H rubber (the third photograph in this section)
* Headlights were changed from incandescent lamps to sealed-beam units, keeping the same housings
* Skirts (obstacle deflectors) were fitted to the leading cars

==== Car body ====
The car body is of steel construction, 18.7 m long, with three pairs of double doors per side. While inheriting the form of the 2000 series from which the bodies were reused, when rebuilt from the 2000 series the cars were also given a voltage-command-type front destination indicator, a skirt, and sealed-beam headlights.

Among the 2600 and 2800 types, the 24 cars that reused the bodies of 2000 series cars 2001–2024 have side windows 100 mm wider at 900 mm than other cars, and their window arrangement differs. Depending on the timing of rebuilding, there are cars with a two-pane window and cars with a single fixed window on the conductor's side of the front; cars completed from November 1980 (Shōwa 55) onward have a single fixed window on the conductor's side of the front.

Among the intermediate 2700 type (M) cars, 2720–2724, and among the 2900 type (T) cars, 2905, 2911, 2915, and 2920–2924, reused the bodies of cars originally built as leading cars, and traces of the removed cabs remain.

2629-2729-2829 is a set that appeared for the purpose of coupling with 2210F, the only 4-car set remaining in the 2200 series, and its form differs from the other 0 subclass cars. Initially, its train-type and destination displays were of the same sequence-type specification as that series, it had no destination indicator below the window of the front door, and its car number was fitted on the front cab side, making it an unusual presence. In September 1988 (Shōwa 63), along with the body renewal of the 2200 series, 2829 had its front door changed to an outward-opening type and a destination indicator fitted below the window of the front door, and 2629 had its cab completely removed and became a 2700 type (the car number unchanged). It became a peculiar car with the control equipment of the 2600 series but the facilities of the 2200 series.

The 2000 series, from which the bodies were reused, also includes three cars that had a history of being transferred from the 2200 series to the 2000 series.

=== 30 subclass (completely newly built cars) ===
The 30 subclass, while basically of the same design as the 0 subclass, was newly built by Kawasaki Heavy Industries, including the car bodies and bogies, to a specification that anticipated the running system of the later 6000 series. From March to May 1981 (Shōwa 56), two 7-car sets were built as replacements for the 1800 series, and in December of the same year, two 7-car sets were built as additional cars to cope with increased transport capacity, for a total of 28 cars, and all entered revenue service within a few days of being built.

With the fourth set of the 30 subclass (2634F), the manufacture of the so-called “egg-shaped trains” that had continued from the 2000 series ended at the set level, and about a year and a half later, in 1983 (Shōwa 58), the 6000 series appeared, greatly overturning the previous image of Keihan. It is considered valuable that car bodies retaining the atmosphere of the dawn of high-performance trains were newly built in the 1980s.

==== Car body ====
While the standards and shape of the car body are identical, it was, as mentioned above, newly manufactured. Unlike the 0 subclass, which fitted sealed-beam units into the incandescent lamp housings of the 2000 series era, the headlights are equipped from the outset with sealed-beam units of the same shape as those from the 2400 series onward. The marker lights, too, unlike the 0 subclass which reused those of the 2000 series, are equipped with the type adopted on the 3000 series. The door windows, unlike the 0 subclass which reused the frameless doors of the 2000 series, have stainless steel frames. At the time of manufacture, gangway bellows were fitted to the front ends, but they were removed in 1986 (Shōwa 61).
章节.Interior: The seats inside are longitudinal (bench) seats. The moquette, decorative panels, and floor are all coordinated in green tones. The interior design is almost the same as that of the 2200 series. As for the side doors, on the 0 subclass the upper half is painted the same green as the decorative panels and the lower half is covered with decorative paneling, whereas on the 30 subclass the entire surface is covered with decorative paneling. The method of supporting the window glass of the side doors also differs.
章节.Equipment:
The maximum speed is 110 km/h and the starting acceleration is 2.5 km/h/s, a major change in performance compared with the 2000 series era. By suppressing acceleration and orienting the cars toward high speed, their performance became almost equivalent to that of the 2200 series. The main motors are the compound-wound “TDK-8135A,” rated at 130 kW at 600 V and 155 kW at 1,500 V. For the controller, the field phase control ACRF-H4155-775A was adopted (both manufactured by Tōyō Denki Seizō). As with the 2000 series, regenerative braking by separately excited field control is used. As for the motor-generator (MG), a large-capacity MG (TDK-3721A) to secure air-conditioning power was installed except on the 3-car sets. Cars 2905–2910 were fitted with a 70 kVA unit (MG: TDK-3721A) to make up for insufficient power capacity when using air conditioning with 4 cars (2905 was removed as a weight-reduction measure when it was incorporated into 2632F to form an 8-car set). Cars 2801–2810 were fitted with a 140 kVA unit (TDK-3755A), with the plan that a single MG as auxiliary power supply would cover the air-conditioning power for three cars.

The pantographs are lower-frame cross-type pantographs (PT-4805A-M) compatible with rigid overhead catenary. Pantographs are fitted not only to all motor cars but also to the control cars 2811–2828 and the trailer cars 2911–2924. The number of fuse boxes beside the pantographs of cars 2601–2610 is two, one fewer than other 2600 type cars.

=== Air-conditioning equipment ===
Every car except those in 2621F and 2622F is equipped with four PRU-2205A units.

2621F and 2622F were test cars for air-conditioning equipment, equipped with three Toshiba RPU-3007 units (10,500 kcal/h); their appearance differs, and nine newly designed grille fans were installed inside the cars to test the cooling effect. Based on the results, Mitsubishi's CU-197 (10,500 kcal/h) was adopted for the 6000 series.

=== Bogies ===
The bogies of this series are diverse; including four types that have already disappeared, they amount to 17 types in total. Bogies have also been exchanged and reassigned, with high-maintenance bogies being replaced by relatively new bogies supplied from withdrawn cars.

FS327A
Manufactured by Sumitomo Metal Industries (now Nippon Steel & Sumitomo Metal → Nippon Steel), Alstom link type. Derived from early 2000 series cars; because the brake shoes are on the outside of the wheels, all are used as trailer bogies due to underfloor space constraints. Their number has decreased, and only one car still uses them.

FS337/337A/337B/337C
Manufactured by Sumitomo Metal Industries (now Nippon Steel & Sumitomo Metal → Nippon Steel), cushion rubber type. FS337B is derived from the T cars of the 2200 series and is used entirely as trailer bogies. The others are derived from mid- and late-period 2000 series cars and are used as motor or trailer bogies.

FS399C
Manufactured by Sumitomo Metal Industries (now Nippon Steel & Sumitomo Metal → Nippon Steel), cushion rubber type. These were used by the 30 subclass T cars when they appeared, and some have been diverted to the 0 subclass with the introduction of the KW79. Used as motor or trailer bogies.

FS509/509A
Manufactured by Sumitomo Metal Industries (now Nippon Steel & Sumitomo Metal → Nippon Steel), SU-type Minden type. Manufactured to replace older bogies and used as motor or trailer bogies. Despite being new, their number has decreased, and the FS509 has already disappeared.

KS58
Manufactured by Kisha Seizō, oil-immersed cylindrical guide type (Schindler type). Derived from early 2000 series cars; because the foundation brake equipment is of the double-shoe type and the brake shoes, linkage levers, and other brake mechanisms are on the outside of the wheels, all are used as trailer bogies due to underfloor space constraints.

KS63/63A/63C
Manufactured by Kisha Seizō, axle-box beam type (economical bogie). Derived from mid-period 2000 series cars and used as motor or trailer bogies. They are said to have had problems with ride comfort, and all have already disappeared.

KS73C
Manufactured by Kisha Seizō, axle-box beam type (economical bogie). Derived from late-period 2000 series cars and used as motor or trailer bogies.

KW37
Manufactured by Kawasaki Heavy Industries, dry cylindrical guide type. Used by the 30 subclass M cars since their appearance, and also manufactured to replace older bogies. Used as motor bogies.

KW69/69A
Manufactured by Kawasaki Heavy Industries, axle-beam type. The KW69 was manufactured to replace the older bogies of this series, and the KW69A those of the 1900 series; the KW69 is used as a motor or trailer bogie, and the KW69A entirely as a trailer bogie.

KW79
Manufactured by Kawasaki Heavy Industries, oil-immersed cylindrical guide type (Schindler type). This is the KS132A used on the 3000 series Tc cars, modified to indirect mounting, and is used entirely on the T and Tc cars of the 30 subclass.

2629-2729-2829 is coupled with the 2200 series. In the mid-1980s it was for a time coupled with the 2400 series, but later returned to its original composition with the 2200 series (at that time coupled with 2210F). After the coupled 2200 series changed in 2006 (Heisei 18) from the regenerative-brake-specification 2210F to the dynamic-brake-specification 2218F, it was withdrawn on November 30, 2009 (Heisei 21).

By changing the combinations of units, sets of 4 to 8 cars can be formed, and operation making use of this feature was carried out. Because withdrawn cars and cars whose cabs were removed (car numbers unchanged) also arose, the sets have become more miscellaneous.

When forming an 8-car set from only 0 subclass cars, the 2800 type (Tc) and 2900 type (T) are always equipped with large-capacity MGs, and because a 4M4T set has constraints such as increased set weight, it was almost always covered as a 5M3T set, but in the past there were also operational records of provisional 8-car 4M4T sets formed by coupling two 4-car sets.

Also, 7-car sets, which had previously been seen only as provisional sets, have been formed as regular sets since around July 2006 (Heisei 18) (they are also listed in the set tables on the official website).

The 30 subclass was built as 7-car sets of a 4-car unit plus a 3-car unit. It can be operated coupled with the 0 subclass. From around the latter half of the 1980s until the September 2003 (Heisei 15) timetable revision, some sets were operated as 5- or 6-car sets by splitting the set and combining with the 0 subclass, but thereafter, as at the time of their appearance, four 7-car sets are formed from the 30 subclass alone.
章节.Modification Work:
=== Conversion of intermediate control cars into intermediate cars ===
For cars with cabs positioned in the middle of sets, from 2007 (Heisei 19) onward work such as removal of the front skirt, crew steps, and crew compartment door grab bars has been carried out. The car numbers have not been changed, but on paper the types have been changed, with the 2600 type becoming the 2700 type and the 2800 type becoming the 2900 type.

=== New livery ===
From 2008 (Heisei 20), a change of car body livery began, and by April 2011 (Heisei 23) it had been carried out on 39 cars. By May 2013 (Heisei 25), the livery change was completed for all cars except those scheduled for withdrawal.

During the period when the new livery was being applied, there were also cases where cars with the old livery and cars with the new livery were mixed within the same set.

In considering the new livery, three kinds of livery were applied to 2825, which had been laid up at Neyagawa Depot. Afterward, 2825 too was given the new livery.

However, the two cars 2615 and 2820, which after withdrawal are used as teaching materials inside Neyagawa Depot, still had the old livery as of September 2017 (Heisei 29).
章节.Keihan Museum Train: In 2010 (Heisei 22), five cars—2602-2702-2802-2712-2812—were used as the touring exhibition “Keihan Museum Train,” carried out as a project commemorating the 100th anniversary of Keihan's opening. These cars had their seats removed and exhibits placed in them, and their livery was repainted in moss green evoking the 1550 type (first-generation 600 type).
章节.Operation:
Among this series, the 0 subclass has mainly been used for local services since the 2000 series era. The 30 subclass was initially also used for express services, but after 8-car-set operation using the 2200 series and 6000 series began on the main line, it too came to be mainly used for local services. However, this type also has operational records of 8-car sets, albeit irregularly. Around the September 2003 timetable revision, operation in 6-car sets disappeared, and after reshuffling, all sets became 4, 5, or 7 cars. Also, with this timetable revision, on weekday morning rush hours a K limited express “Orihime” through service from Katano Line's Kisaichi Station to Yodoyabashi Station, and in the same evening rush hours a semi-express “Hikoboshi” from Tenmabashi Station to Kisaichi, were established; except during events, the former was assigned a 5-car set of this series, and the latter was assigned a 1900 series or a 5-car set of this series.

The 30 subclass also entered the Uji Line and Katano Line as 5-car sets, and was also assigned to “Orihime.”

It does not support the one-man operation implemented on the Katano Line from September 2007 (Heisei 19), and is not used in operations that involve one-man operation.

“Orihime” and “Hikoboshi” became, with the October 19, 2008 (Heisei 20) timetable revision, commuter express and rapid express services through-running to the Katano Line and Nakanoshima Line respectively, and both were assigned 5-car sets of this series (except for one “Hikoboshi” assigned a 10000 series), but they were abolished with the March 16, 2013 (Heisei 25) timetable revision.

Also, with the appearance of the 13000 series and the start of one-man operation on the Uji Line, regular operation of the 2600 series even for 4-car sets ended as of May 2013 (Heisei 25).

Thereafter, like the 7-car sets of other types, it was used only for express services and below, but with the March 19, 2016 (Heisei 28) timetable revision, commuter express and rapid express operations using 7-car sets were established, and although not “Orihime”/“Hikoboshi” operations, opportunities for commuter express and rapid express operation of this series revived for the first time in three years.

Since the September 2021 (Reiwa 5) timetable revision, regular operation of 0 subclass cars has ceased.
章节.Withdrawal:
=== 0 subclass ===
As for the 0 subclass, withdrawals began in 2001 (Heisei 13); as of December 28, 2001 (Heisei 13), 2622F (4-car set) and 2905, 2906, 2910 were withdrawn; as of March 18, 2002 (Heisei 14), 2611F (4-car set); as of April 22 of the same year, 2627-2827 and 2714-2814; and as of April 25 of the same year, 2616F (4-car set).

The cars withdrawn at this time were offered for sale to outside parties in March 2003 (Heisei 15), and a front-end cut model of car 2627 was transferred to an individual railway fan. Also, the front end of car 2811 was transferred to Kids Plaza Osaka, where it is used as a wheelchair experience facility inside the building. In addition, bogies (one each of FS-509 and FS-327A) were transferred to the Institute of Industrial Science, the University of Tokyo.

Subsequently, as of March 29, 2006 (Heisei 18), 2618-2918, 2907, 2908 were withdrawn.

2629-2729-2829, which had been coupled with the 2200 series, was also taken out of service together with the four cars including 2218 that it had been coupled with, due to the September 12, 2009 (Heisei 21) timetable change, and both were withdrawn as is on November 30. Also, 2610F, 2612-2912, and 2909 were withdrawn as of the same date.

On December 31, 2010 (Heisei 22), 2602, 2702, 2802, 2712, and 2812, which had been used as the aforementioned “Keihan Museum Train,” were withdrawn.

2604F, which had been given the new livery, was also withdrawn as of June 30, 2011 (Heisei 23), together with 2724-2824, which had been coupled with it.

From April to July 2012 (Heisei 24), five 4-car sets of the 13000 series (13001F–13005F) were introduced, and five 4-car sets—2613F, 2615F, 2617F, 2620F, 2621F—were withdrawn. Of these, 2-car sets were formed from one leading car each of 2615F and 2620F (2615-2820), which became teaching-material cars at Neyagawa Depot.

Furthermore, as of April 30, 2013 (Heisei 25), 2606, 2706, 2806, 2626, 2826, 2605, 2705, 2805 were withdrawn, and as of May 31 of the same year, 2628, 2828, 2608, 2708, 2808 were withdrawn. Subsequently, 2623F, which had been a spare set for the Uji Line since March 2013 (Heisei 25), was withdrawn as of July 31, 2015 (Heisei 27).

From fiscal 2016 (Heisei 28) to fiscal 2020 (Reiwa 2), because of the installation of platform screen doors at Kyōbashi Station, replacement of the 5000 series, whose boarding/alighting positions differ, was given priority, so there were no withdrawals of this type, and as of April 2021 (Reiwa 3), the 0 subclass, consisting of cars reusing 2000 series bodies, had three 7-car sets in service. Of these, 2624 and 2818 are cars that reused the bodies of first-batch 2000 series cars (the original bodies being 2007 and 2006), and while undergoing changes such as car body livery change and conversion of headlights to LED, they reached 60 years since the manufacture of their bodies in 2019 (Reiwa 1). Afterward, with the replacement of the 5000 series largely completed, withdrawals resumed in 2021 (Reiwa 3), and 2609F was withdrawn as of July 6. Of these, a 2-car set was formed from one leading car each of 2609F (2609-2825), becoming the second-generation teaching-material car at Neyagawa Depot and replacing (2615-2820).

Furthermore, as of September 12, 2022 (Reiwa 4), 2601, 2701, 2801 were withdrawn.

As of November 8, 2023 (Reiwa 5), 2624F, and as of December 5 of the same year, 2718, 2818, 2619, 2819 were withdrawn, and the 2600 series 0 subclass disappeared except for the aforementioned teaching-material cars at Neyagawa Depot.

=== 30 subclass ===
Meanwhile, as for the 30 subclass, since their appearance, removal of the front gangway bellows of the leading cars, a change of car body livery to the new livery, and conversion of headlights to LED were carried out, but renewal work was not carried out, and as of April 2025 (Reiwa 7), a total of 14 cars—two 7-car sets—remain in service.

On October 25, 2024 (Reiwa 6), it was announced that 67 cars of the 13000 series would be introduced by fiscal 2026 (Reiwa 8), and that they, together with the remaining 1000, 2200, and 2400 series, would be replaced in combination with the reshuffling of existing 13000 series cars; the 30 subclass is also scheduled to be replaced in turn, and in March 2025 (Reiwa 7), 2633F and 2634F were withdrawn.

As of August 21, 2026, it ended revenue operation together with the 2200 series and 2400 series.

英文.全文:
The Keihan 2600 series electric car (Keihan 2600-kei densha) is a commuter electric car of Keihan Electric Railway (Keihan) that entered service in 1978 (Shōwa 53).

A total of 131 cars were built: 103 cars of the 0 subclass, which were manufactured at the company's own Neyagawa Vehicle Works by reusing the car bodies, bogies, and some equipment of the 2000 series that entered service in 1959 (Shōwa 34) (103 cars in all, including 3 cars transferred from the 2200 series), and 28 cars of the 30 subclass, which were manufactured entirely new, including their car bodies, at Kawasaki Heavy Industries' Hyōgo Works.

Withdrawals began in 2001 (Heisei 13), and as of April 1, 2025 (Reiwa 7), a total of 14 cars remain in service, consisting of two 7-car sets of the 30 subclass.

== Circumstances of Introduction and Overview ==
Because the “0 subclass” and the “30 subclass” have completely different circumstances of introduction, they are described separately.

=== 0 subclass (cars rebuilt from the 2000 series) ===

==== Manufacturing background: the 2000 series and the 2600 series 0 subclass ====
The 2000 series, which entered service in 1959 (Shōwa 34) and was affectionately known by the nickname “Supercar,” was difficult to equip with air conditioning and to adapt to the increase in overhead wire voltage from 600 V to 1,500 V that had been under consideration since the 1970s, and replacing all 103 cars of the 2000 series with newly built cars was also difficult.

Toward the voltage increase decided to be carried out in 1983 (Shōwa 58), the 2000 series, which was relatively young among the cars then in service, was, unlike the 2200 series, to be given new car types and numbers at the company's own works (Neyagawa Vehicle Works) in the form of “car body reuse,” in which the cars would not inherit their registration but would be positioned as newly built cars (replacement new construction) on paper, and to be updated and adapted to the higher voltage.

In replacing the 2000 series, which was at most about 20 years old (at the time), starting in 1978 (Shōwa 53) with set 2043 as the first, the cars were rebuilt successively by reusing the car bodies, bogies, and some equipment of the 2000 series while converting to dual-voltage control equipment with regenerative braking and adding air conditioning and other modifications, and were completed as the 2600 series 0 subclass, effectively updated cars of the 2000 series (cars rebuilt from the 2000 series); replacement with the 2600 series 0 subclass was completed in 1982 (Shōwa 57). They almost retain their appearance from the 2000 series era, and in the “Tetsudō Collection” models released by Keihan in 2016 (Heisei 28) and 2017 (Heisei 29), this was faithfully reproduced, and they were labeled with the designations “2600 series first batch” and “2600 series second batch” (both meaning the first and second batches of the 2000 series), which are classifications that do not exist for the 2600 series, essentially treating them as identical to the 2000 series. Also, in a memorial exhibition for the retirement of the series held at “SANZEN-HIROBA” inside Kuzuha Mall from August 26, 2026 (scheduled to end September 30 of the same year), the photographs of cars displayed there, together with a photograph of a 2000 series car (car 2018), were captioned “Thank you, 2600 series,” likewise treating the 2000 series and the 2600 series 0 subclass as identical despite being different cars on paper.

The manufacturer's nameplate installed inside the cars does not bear the name of the maker that built the reused 2000 series car bodies, but reads “Keihan Electric Railway Neyagawa Works.”

On June 23, 1978 (Shōwa 53), 2601F (2601-2701-2801), which reused the car bodies of 2043, 2128, and 2044, was completed, and up to 2905 (formerly 2064), completed on December 1, 1982 (Shōwa 57), a total of 103 cars were rebuilt at the Neyagawa Works. The composition at the time of completion of all cars was five 3-car sets, six 4-car fixed sets, fourteen 4-car sets splittable into 2+2 cars, and four 2-car sets.

The composition of the basic sets was the same as in the 2000 series era (e.g., a 3-car 2000 series set was rebuilt and renumbered as is into a 3-car 2600 series 0 subclass set).

Main contents of the update (rebuilding into the 2600 series)
* Main motors, main controllers, and other main control equipment were replaced with newly built items compatible with the higher voltage
* Diamond-shaped pantographs were replaced with lower-frame cross-type pantographs
* To guard against risks such as poor regenerative braking due to contact loss, pantographs were also fitted to trailer cars
* Destination indicators were installed on the front of the leading cars, and at the same time the position of the car number was moved from the front gangway door to below the cab-side window (on the right as viewed)
* In sets rebuilt in the latter period, the window on the assistant driver's side (on the left as viewed) of the front of the leading car was changed to a single fixed window supported by H rubber (the third photograph in this section)
* Headlights were changed from incandescent lamps to sealed-beam units, keeping the same housings
* Skirts (obstacle deflectors) were fitted to the leading cars

==== Car body ====
The car body is of steel construction, 18.7 m long, with three pairs of double doors per side. While inheriting the form of the 2000 series from which the bodies were reused, when rebuilt from the 2000 series the cars were also given a voltage-command-type front destination indicator, a skirt, and sealed-beam headlights.

Among the 2600 and 2800 types, the 24 cars that reused the bodies of 2000 series cars 2001–2024 have side windows 100 mm wider at 900 mm than other cars, and their window arrangement differs. Depending on the timing of rebuilding, there are cars with a two-pane window and cars with a single fixed window on the conductor's side of the front; cars completed from November 1980 (Shōwa 55) onward have a single fixed window on the conductor's side of the front.

Among the intermediate 2700 type (M) cars, 2720–2724, and among the 2900 type (T) cars, 2905, 2911, 2915, and 2920–2924, reused the bodies of cars originally built as leading cars, and traces of the removed cabs remain.

2629-2729-2829 is a set that appeared for the purpose of coupling with 2210F, the only 4-car set remaining in the 2200 series, and its form differs from the other 0 subclass cars. Initially, its train-type and destination displays were of the same sequence-type specification as that series, it had no destination indicator below the window of the front door, and its car number was fitted on the front cab side, making it an unusual presence. In September 1988 (Shōwa 63), along with the body renewal of the 2200 series, 2829 had its front door changed to an outward-opening type and a destination indicator fitted below the window of the front door, and 2629 had its cab completely removed and became a 2700 type (the car number unchanged). It became a peculiar car with the control equipment of the 2600 series but the facilities of the 2200 series.

The 2000 series, from which the bodies were reused, also includes three cars that had a history of being transferred from the 2200 series to the 2000 series.

=== 30 subclass (completely newly built cars) ===
The 30 subclass, while basically of the same design as the 0 subclass, was newly built by Kawasaki Heavy Industries, including the car bodies and bogies, to a specification that anticipated the running system of the later 6000 series. From March to May 1981 (Shōwa 56), two 7-car sets were built as replacements for the 1800 series, and in December of the same year, two 7-car sets were built as additional cars to cope with increased transport capacity, for a total of 28 cars, and all entered revenue service within a few days of being built.

With the fourth set of the 30 subclass (2634F), the manufacture of the so-called “egg-shaped trains” that had continued from the 2000 series ended at the set level, and about a year and a half later, in 1983 (Shōwa 58), the 6000 series appeared, greatly overturning the previous image of Keihan. It is considered valuable that car bodies retaining the atmosphere of the dawn of high-performance trains were newly built in the 1980s.

==== Car body ====
While the standards and shape of the car body are identical, it was, as mentioned above, newly manufactured. Unlike the 0 subclass, which fitted sealed-beam units into the incandescent lamp housings of the 2000 series era, the headlights are equipped from the outset with sealed-beam units of the same shape as those from the 2400 series onward. The marker lights, too, unlike the 0 subclass which reused those of the 2000 series, are equipped with the type adopted on the 3000 series. The door windows, unlike the 0 subclass which reused the frameless doors of the 2000 series, have stainless steel frames. At the time of manufacture, gangway bellows were fitted to the front ends, but they were removed in 1986 (Shōwa 61).

== Interior ==
The seats inside are longitudinal (bench) seats. The moquette, decorative panels, and floor are all coordinated in green tones. The interior design is almost the same as that of the 2200 series. As for the side doors, on the 0 subclass the upper half is painted the same green as the decorative panels and the lower half is covered with decorative paneling, whereas on the 30 subclass the entire surface is covered with decorative paneling. The method of supporting the window glass of the side doors also differs.

== Equipment ==
The maximum speed is 110 km/h and the starting acceleration is 2.5 km/h/s, a major change in performance compared with the 2000 series era. By suppressing acceleration and orienting the cars toward high speed, their performance became almost equivalent to that of the 2200 series. The main motors are the compound-wound “TDK-8135A,” rated at 130 kW at 600 V and 155 kW at 1,500 V. For the controller, the field phase control ACRF-H4155-775A was adopted (both manufactured by Tōyō Denki Seizō). As with the 2000 series, regenerative braking by separately excited field control is used. As for the motor-generator (MG), a large-capacity MG (TDK-3721A) to secure air-conditioning power was installed except on the 3-car sets. Cars 2905–2910 were fitted with a 70 kVA unit (MG: TDK-3721A) to make up for insufficient power capacity when using air conditioning with 4 cars (2905 was removed as a weight-reduction measure when it was incorporated into 2632F to form an 8-car set). Cars 2801–2810 were fitted with a 140 kVA unit (TDK-3755A), with the plan that a single MG as auxiliary power supply would cover the air-conditioning power for three cars.

The pantographs are lower-frame cross-type pantographs (PT-4805A-M) compatible with rigid overhead catenary. Pantographs are fitted not only to all motor cars but also to the control cars 2811–2828 and the trailer cars 2911–2924. The number of fuse boxes beside the pantographs of cars 2601–2610 is two, one fewer than other 2600 type cars.

=== Air-conditioning equipment ===
Every car except those in 2621F and 2622F is equipped with four PRU-2205A units.

2621F and 2622F were test cars for air-conditioning equipment, equipped with three Toshiba RPU-3007 units (10,500 kcal/h); their appearance differs, and nine newly designed grille fans were installed inside the cars to test the cooling effect. Based on the results, Mitsubishi's CU-197 (10,500 kcal/h) was adopted for the 6000 series.

=== Bogies ===
The bogies of this series are diverse; including four types that have already disappeared, they amount to 17 types in total. Bogies have also been exchanged and reassigned, with high-maintenance bogies being replaced by relatively new bogies supplied from withdrawn cars.

FS327A
Manufactured by Sumitomo Metal Industries (now Nippon Steel & Sumitomo Metal → Nippon Steel), Alstom link type. Derived from early 2000 series cars; because the brake shoes are on the outside of the wheels, all are used as trailer bogies due to underfloor space constraints. Their number has decreased, and only one car still uses them.

FS337/337A/337B/337C
Manufactured by Sumitomo Metal Industries (now Nippon Steel & Sumitomo Metal → Nippon Steel), cushion rubber type. FS337B is derived from the T cars of the 2200 series and is used entirely as trailer bogies. The others are derived from mid- and late-period 2000 series cars and are used as motor or trailer bogies.

FS399C
Manufactured by Sumitomo Metal Industries (now Nippon Steel & Sumitomo Metal → Nippon Steel), cushion rubber type. These were used by the 30 subclass T cars when they appeared, and some have been diverted to the 0 subclass with the introduction of the KW79. Used as motor or trailer bogies.

FS509/509A
Manufactured by Sumitomo Metal Industries (now Nippon Steel & Sumitomo Metal → Nippon Steel), SU-type Minden type. Manufactured to replace older bogies and used as motor or trailer bogies. Despite being new, their number has decreased, and the FS509 has already disappeared.

KS58
Manufactured by Kisha Seizō, oil-immersed cylindrical guide type (Schindler type). Derived from early 2000 series cars; because the foundation brake equipment is of the double-shoe type and the brake shoes, linkage levers, and other brake mechanisms are on the outside of the wheels, all are used as trailer bogies due to underfloor space constraints.

KS63/63A/63C
Manufactured by Kisha Seizō, axle-box beam type (economical bogie). Derived from mid-period 2000 series cars and used as motor or trailer bogies. They are said to have had problems with ride comfort, and all have already disappeared.

KS73C
Manufactured by Kisha Seizō, axle-box beam type (economical bogie). Derived from late-period 2000 series cars and used as motor or trailer bogies.

KW37
Manufactured by Kawasaki Heavy Industries, dry cylindrical guide type. Used by the 30 subclass M cars since their appearance, and also manufactured to replace older bogies. Used as motor bogies.

KW69/69A
Manufactured by Kawasaki Heavy Industries, axle-beam type. The KW69 was manufactured to replace the older bogies of this series, and the KW69A those of the 1900 series; the KW69 is used as a motor or trailer bogie, and the KW69A entirely as a trailer bogie.

KW79
Manufactured by Kawasaki Heavy Industries, oil-immersed cylindrical guide type (Schindler type). This is the KS132A used on the 3000 series Tc cars, modified to indirect mounting, and is used entirely on the T and Tc cars of the 30 subclass.

Because at one time through service from Demachiyanagi Station to the Eizan Electric Railway line was considered before the opening of the Kamōtō Line, the specification allows operation in a minimum 2-car set to match Eizan's transport demand, but the through-service plan was never realized and this specification has not been used.

2629-2729-2829 is coupled with the 2200 series. In the mid-1980s it was for a time coupled with the 2400 series, but later returned to its original composition with the 2200 series (at that time coupled with 2210F). After the coupled 2200 series changed in 2006 (Heisei 18) from the regenerative-brake-specification 2210F to the dynamic-brake-specification 2218F, it was withdrawn on November 30, 2009 (Heisei 21).

By changing the combinations of units, sets of 4 to 8 cars can be formed, and operation making use of this feature was carried out. Because withdrawn cars and cars whose cabs were removed (car numbers unchanged) also arose, the sets have become more miscellaneous.

When forming an 8-car set from only 0 subclass cars, the 2800 type (Tc) and 2900 type (T) are always equipped with large-capacity MGs, and because a 4M4T set has constraints such as increased set weight, it was almost always covered as a 5M3T set, but in the past there were also operational records of provisional 8-car 4M4T sets formed by coupling two 4-car sets.

Also, 7-car sets, which had previously been seen only as provisional sets, have been formed as regular sets since around July 2006 (Heisei 18) (they are also listed in the set tables on the official website).

The 30 subclass was built as 7-car sets of a 4-car unit plus a 3-car unit. It can be operated coupled with the 0 subclass. From around the latter half of the 1980s until the September 2003 (Heisei 15) timetable revision, some sets were operated as 5- or 6-car sets by splitting the set and combining with the 0 subclass, but thereafter, as at the time of their appearance, four 7-car sets are formed from the 30 subclass alone.

== Modification Work ==
=== Conversion of intermediate control cars into intermediate cars ===
For cars with cabs positioned in the middle of sets, from 2007 (Heisei 19) onward work such as removal of the front skirt, crew steps, and crew compartment door grab bars has been carried out. The car numbers have not been changed, but on paper the types have been changed, with the 2600 type becoming the 2700 type and the 2800 type becoming the 2900 type.

=== New livery ===
From 2008 (Heisei 20), a change of car body livery began, and by April 2011 (Heisei 23) it had been carried out on 39 cars. By May 2013 (Heisei 25), the livery change was completed for all cars except those scheduled for withdrawal.

During the period when the new livery was being applied, there were also cases where cars with the old livery and cars with the new livery were mixed within the same set.

In considering the new livery, three kinds of livery were applied to 2825, which had been laid up at Neyagawa Depot. Afterward, 2825 too was given the new livery.

However, the two cars 2615 and 2820, which after withdrawal are used as teaching materials inside Neyagawa Depot, still had the old livery as of September 2017 (Heisei 29).

== Keihan Museum Train ==
In 2010 (Heisei 22), five cars—2602-2702-2802-2712-2812—were used as the touring exhibition “Keihan Museum Train,” carried out as a project commemorating the 100th anniversary of Keihan's opening. These cars had their seats removed and exhibits placed in them, and their livery was repainted in moss green evoking the 1550 type (first-generation 600 type).

== Operation ==
Among this series, the 0 subclass has mainly been used for local services since the 2000 series era. The 30 subclass was initially also used for express services, but after 8-car-set operation using the 2200 series and 6000 series began on the main line, it too came to be mainly used for local services. However, this type also has operational records of 8-car sets, albeit irregularly. Around the September 2003 timetable revision, operation in 6-car sets disappeared, and after reshuffling, all sets became 4, 5, or 7 cars. Also, with this timetable revision, on weekday morning rush hours a K limited express “Orihime” through service from Katano Line's Kisaichi Station to Yodoyabashi Station, and in the same evening rush hours a semi-express “Hikoboshi” from Tenmabashi Station to Kisaichi, were established; except during events, the former was assigned a 5-car set of this series, and the latter was assigned a 1900 series or a 5-car set of this series.

The 30 subclass also entered the Uji Line and Katano Line as 5-car sets, and was also assigned to “Orihime.”

It does not support the one-man operation implemented on the Katano Line from September 2007 (Heisei 19), and is not used in operations that involve one-man operation.

“Orihime” and “Hikoboshi” became, with the October 19, 2008 (Heisei 20) timetable revision, commuter express and rapid express services through-running to the Katano Line and Nakanoshima Line respectively, and both were assigned 5-car sets of this series (except for one “Hikoboshi” assigned a 10000 series), but they were abolished with the March 16, 2013 (Heisei 25) timetable revision.

Also, with the appearance of the 13000 series and the start of one-man operation on the Uji Line, regular operation of the 2600 series even for 4-car sets ended as of May 2013 (Heisei 25).

Thereafter, like the 7-car sets of other types, it was used only for express services and below, but with the March 19, 2016 (Heisei 28) timetable revision, commuter express and rapid express operations using 7-car sets were established, and although not “Orihime”/“Hikoboshi” operations, opportunities for commuter express and rapid express operation of this series revived for the first time in three years.

Since the September 2021 (Reiwa 5) timetable revision, regular operation of 0 subclass cars has ceased.

== Withdrawal ==
=== 0 subclass ===
As for the 0 subclass, withdrawals began in 2001 (Heisei 13); as of December 28, 2001 (Heisei 13), 2622F (4-car set) and 2905, 2906, 2910 were withdrawn; as of March 18, 2002 (Heisei 14), 2611F (4-car set); as of April 22 of the same year, 2627-2827 and 2714-2814; and as of April 25 of the same year, 2616F (4-car set).

The cars withdrawn at this time were offered for sale to outside parties in March 2003 (Heisei 15), and a front-end cut model of car 2627 was transferred to an individual railway fan. Also, the front end of car 2811 was transferred to Kids Plaza Osaka, where it is used as a wheelchair experience facility inside the building. In addition, bogies (one each of FS-509 and FS-327A) were transferred to the Institute of Industrial Science, the University of Tokyo.

Subsequently, as of March 29, 2006 (Heisei 18), 2618-2918, 2907, 2908 were withdrawn.

2629-2729-2829, which had been coupled with the 2200 series, was also taken out of service together with the four cars including 2218 that it had been coupled with, due to the September 12, 2009 (Heisei 21) timetable change, and both were withdrawn as is on November 30. Also, 2610F, 2612-2912, and 2909 were withdrawn as of the same date.

On December 31, 2010 (Heisei 22), 2602, 2702, 2802, 2712, and 2812, which had been used as the aforementioned “Keihan Museum Train,” were withdrawn.

2604F, which had been given the new livery, was also withdrawn as of June 30, 2011 (Heisei 23), together with 2724-2824, which had been coupled with it.

From April to July 2012 (Heisei 24), five 4-car sets of the 13000 series (13001F–13005F) were introduced, and five 4-car sets—2613F, 2615F, 2617F, 2620F, 2621F—were withdrawn. Of these, 2-car sets were formed from one leading car each of 2615F and 2620F (2615-2820), which became teaching-material cars at Neyagawa Depot.

Furthermore, as of April 30, 2013 (Heisei 25), 2606, 2706, 2806, 2626, 2826, 2605, 2705, 2805 were withdrawn, and as of May 31 of the same year, 2628, 2828, 2608, 2708, 2808 were withdrawn. Subsequently, 2623F, which had been a spare set for the Uji Line since March 2013 (Heisei 25), was withdrawn as of July 31, 2015 (Heisei 27).

From fiscal 2016 (Heisei 28) to fiscal 2020 (Reiwa 2), because of the installation of platform screen doors at Kyōbashi Station, replacement of the 5000 series, whose boarding/alighting positions differ, was given priority, so there were no withdrawals of this type, and as of April 2021 (Reiwa 3), the 0 subclass, consisting of cars reusing 2000 series bodies, had three 7-car sets in service. Of these, 2624 and 2818 are cars that reused the bodies of first-batch 2000 series cars (the original bodies being 2007 and 2006), and while undergoing changes such as car body livery change and conversion of headlights to LED, they reached 60 years since the manufacture of their bodies in 2019 (Reiwa 1). Afterward, with the replacement of the 5000 series largely completed, withdrawals resumed in 2021 (Reiwa 3), and 2609F was withdrawn as of July 6. Of these, a 2-car set was formed from one leading car each of 2609F (2609-2825), becoming the second-generation teaching-material car at Neyagawa Depot and replacing (2615-2820).

Furthermore, as of September 12, 2022 (Reiwa 4), 2601, 2701, 2801 were withdrawn.

As of November 8, 2023 (Reiwa 5), 2624F, and as of December 5 of the same year, 2718, 2818, 2619, 2819 were withdrawn, and the 2600 series 0 subclass disappeared except for the aforementioned teaching-material cars at Neyagawa Depot.

=== 30 subclass ===
Meanwhile, as for the 30 subclass, since their appearance, removal of the front gangway bellows of the leading cars, a change of car body livery to the new livery, and conversion of headlights to LED were carried out, but renewal work was not carried out, and as of April 2025 (Reiwa 7), a total of 14 cars—two 7-car sets—remain in service.

On October 25, 2024 (Reiwa 6), it was announced that 67 cars of the 13000 series would be introduced by fiscal 2026 (Reiwa 8), and that they, together with the remaining 1000, 2200, and 2400 series, would be replaced in combination with the reshuffling of existing 13000 series cars; the 30 subclass is also scheduled to be replaced in turn, and in March 2025 (Reiwa 7), 2633F and 2634F were withdrawn.

As of August 21, 2026, it ended revenue operation together with the 2200 series and 2400 series.

== Preserved Cars ==
When “SANZEN-HIROBA” at Kuzuha Mall was renewed in April 2023 (Reiwa 5), car 2601 was preserved in the form of a cut body with its cab section.

== Other ==
2621F became a test car for a train monitor using optical fiber, along with confirmation of the performance of a new air conditioner.

The four cars of 2626F and 2628F were brought in as test-run cars for the construction of the Kyoto underground line in 1986 (Shōwa 61) through a temporary access opening provided near Matsubara-dōri, and were used to check underground facilities in the underground line, for test runs, for checking ATS equipment, and finally for driver training runs.

From 2004 (Heisei 16) to 2008 (Heisei 20), anti-fall gangway bellows were fitted at the coupling sections.

From 2009 (Heisei 21), protection radios have been fitted to cars entering for inspection.

Since 2014 (Heisei 26), Keihan has carried out modifications to change the headlights of existing cars from sealed beam to LED.

Car 2803 retains traces of having had an anti-fall gangway bellows on its front because it was in the middle of a set for a time.

At the aforementioned “SANZEN-HIROBA,” a 2600 series driving simulator is installed, and the driver can select from a total of six options—three kinds of express and three kinds of local—to drive. It costs 300 yen per play, and driving ends when the driver completes the driving section to the end or when the time limit is reached. Until August 2024 (Reiwa 6), three kinds of main-line limited express driving were available.
